title: chtypes goldens v1 runner report
description: What one binding's goldens runner emits, on one platform, for one goldens document. A runner EXECUTES the cases and RECORDS what the library returned; it never compares. scripts/goldens-v1/compare.py reads this report next to the goldens document and renders every verdict. Every byte field is standard base64 of the exact bytes the library returned.

binding_version.description: the binding's own version as it reports it

platform.description: the platform the runner ran on; must be one of the goldens document's generated.checked_on

goldens.description: the identity of the goldens document the runner executed, copied from that document

sha256.description: sha256 of the document's exact bytes as fetched, lowercase hex with no prefix

artifact.description: the loaded library, read from the library itself and never from the manifest

abi_fingerprint.description: the loaded library's ABI fingerprint; must equal the goldens document's abi_fingerprint

cases.description: one entry per case of the goldens document, in any order; a case missing from this list is a FAIL, and so is an id the document does not name

error.description: chs_error_ch_code, chs_error_ch_name, chs_error_message and chs_error_column, the last three as base64 bytes

setup.description: the id of the setup whose process ran the case

result.description: skipped is allowed ONLY when the report's platform is not among the case's platforms; a skip anywhere else is a FAIL

skip_reason.description: required when skipped: the platforms exclusion, in words

at.description: the step the call sequence stopped at: the first step that did not answer CHS_OK, else call

error.description: present exactly when status is not CHS_OK

document_b64.description: present exactly when status is CHS_OK: the output document's exact bytes as the library returned them (for schema_create, chs_schema_describe's), never parsed and re-serialized, never trimmed

export_b64.description: preview_batch with an export format other than -1 and status CHS_OK: out_export's exact bytes; absent otherwise

decoded_ok.description: when status is CHS_OK, whether the binding's PUBLIC decoder accepted document_b64 without error (the same call a user makes); null when there is no document to decode
